info.name: HustleHub+ API
info.description:
# HustleHub+ API, Part 1

Covers registration, login, authentication, role enforcement and full CRUD on all six
marketplace resources.

## Running the collection

1. Start MongoDB, then run `npm run certs` once.
2. Run `npm run db:reset`. This empties the database and seeds the Admin account, which
   the collection signs in as. The suite uses fixed email addresses, so it expects to
   start from an empty database.
3. Run `npm start`.
4. Run `npm run test:api`. That feeds `baseUrl`, `adminEmail` and `adminPassword` in from
   your `.env`, so the Admin password is never stored in this file.

To run it from the Postman app instead, turn off Settings > General > SSL certificate
verification, because the development certificate is self signed, and create an
environment supplying `adminEmail` and `adminPassword`.

## The cast

Four accounts are created in section 1 and reused throughout: two Clients and two
Freelancers. The Admin is created out of band by `npm run seed:admin`, because
registration refuses the Admin role and changing a role is itself Admin only.

## What is asserted

Alongside each request its own tests, every response in the collection is checked to
confirm it is JSON and that it never contains a password hash, a file path or a stack
trace. Section 12 confirms the suite deleted every marketplace record it created.
